finding: Black losses IDENTICAL (76->76); 16 draws became wins. Conversion improves against a real opponent, not just in self-play.
but: Relative strength UNCHANGED: overall 0.5763 -> 0.5837 is ~0.5 SE at n=400. These are ENGINE-level changes, so v21b-as-Black converts better too and V22 White falls 0.6975 -> 0.6725.
implication: The rule/engine changes fix conversion for whoever plays Black. They do not make one model stronger than another, and they do not substitute for a better model.
